proof_body:
by
  intro p q f₁ f₂ y₁ v₁ y₂ v₂ c₁ c₂ t h₁ h₁' h₂ h₂'
  have h3 : HasDerivAt (fun s => c₁ * v₁ s + c₂ * v₂ s)
      (c₁ * (f₁ t - p t * v₁ t - q t * y₁ t) + c₂ * (f₂ t - p t * v₂ t - q t * y₂ t)) t :=
    (h₁'.const_mul c₁).add (h₂'.const_mul c₂)
  exact ⟨(h₁.const_mul c₁).add (h₂.const_mul c₂), h3.congr_deriv (by ring)⟩
target_source: ∀ (p q f₁ f₂ y₁ v₁ y₂ v₂ : ℝ → ℝ) (c₁ c₂ t : ℝ), HasDerivAt y₁ (v₁ t) t → HasDerivAt v₁ (f₁ t - p t * v₁ t - q t * y₁ t) t → HasDerivAt y₂ (v₂ t) t → HasDerivAt v₂ (f₂ t - p t * v₂ t - q t * y₂ t) t → HasDerivAt (fun s => c₁ * y₁ s + c₂ * y₂ s) (c₁ * v₁ t + c₂ * v₂ t) t ∧ HasDerivAt (fun s => c₁ * v₁ s + c₂ * v₂ s) (c₁ * f₁ t + c₂ * f₂ t - p t * (c₁ * v₁ t + c₂ * v₂ t) - q t * (c₁ * y₁ t + c₂ * y₂ t)) t
